authority.new_artifact_hashes: jlens_io_v1.py, jlens_parity_runner_v1.py, test_jlens_io_v1.py, test_jlens_parity_runner_v1.py and PARITY_PLAN_V1.json SHA-256 are recorded in IO_PARITY_HANDOFF_V1.md after freeze; never fabricated here.

scope.this_phase: model-free pinning/cache loader + prospective parity harness
explicitly_not_done: no fits, no forward, no network, no download, no install
no generation, logit-behaviour study or steering
no live capture or scoring release created
reuse: existing prompted/unprompted cached views and admitted 240 TRAIN / 80 validation manifests

runtime_pins.parity_runtime: repository .venv (torch 2.13.0+cpu, transformers 5.15.1, tokenizers 0.23.0rc0, safetensors 0.8.0, transformer-lens 4.0.0b1, numpy 2.5.2); hashes of the named provider source files must be pinned in the reviewed lock
runtime_pins.later_fitting_runtime: development/classifier_generalization_v2 locked classifier.runtime (sklearn lbfgs); no installs

caps.note: PROVISIONAL; freeze in the root-prepared lock and confirm in independent review before execution

prompt_rule.selection: predeclared before execution; the pool is ordered by case_id and the prompt text/hash is carried in the lock; no class label or outcome is read or used

same_forward_comparison.model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B revision 2fc06364715b967f1860aea9cf38778875588b17, raw float32, eager attention, local_files_only
same_forward_comparison.bridge_construction: TransformerBridge.boot_transformers(model_name, hf_model=<the already-loaded model object>, tokenizer=<the already-loaded tokenizer>, device='cpu', dtype=torch.float32); hf_model= is the installed constructor path that reuses the loaded model and avoids a second load/download
same_forward_comparison.native_capture: plain torch forward hooks on the original HF decoder layers for 6/10/18
same_forward_comparison.layer_convention: layer l is the OUTPUT of block l at blocks.{l}.hook_out; layer-output, not lens layer-input

fail_closed.trigger: same-model blocks.{l}.hook_out cannot be produced from the same object and same forward
fail_closed.action: raise SAME_MODEL_HOOK_UNAVAILABLE and write no success receipt
fail_closed.exact_minimal_alternative: one bridge.run_with_cache on the already-loaded model with a names_filter for blocks.{6,10,18}.hook_out plus plain torch forward hooks on the original HF decoder layers, comparing those same-forward recordings; a second model load, a second forward, or a fabricated value is not acceptable

readout_validation.core: jlens_core_v2.raw_direct_logit (transport -> (1 + weight) float32 norm -> selected unembedding rows)
readout_validation.reference: published JacobianLens.transport plus the library's own _unembed applied to the SAME captured hidden state (no second forward)
readout_validation.selected_tokens: single-token encodings of the <= 6 frozen concept surfaces, add_special_tokens=False
readout_validation.unembed_rows: at most 6 rows read by byte range from model.safetensors; the 248320 x 1024 matrix is never materialized
readout_validation.dtype: norm and unembedding loaded as float32; bf16/f16 storage is upcast, never rounded and never used as the compute dtype
readout_validation.residual_reported: max abs difference per layer versus the locked tolerance; raw logits only, never called a probability

lens.container: torch zip; torch.load(weights_only=True) only, behind the release token; unsafe pickle rejected

model.selection: header + per-row byte slicing only; no whole-vocabulary read

cached_views.prefix_alignment: prefix_length == readout_index + 1; token_positions contiguous ending at readout_index

loader_contract.zero_score_preflight: reads no cached readout, performs no fit and makes no new tokenizer/model call; only path/size/header/metadata checks and small public manifest reads

material_risks: the published lens revision is not proven to be the exact fit revision of the pinned model; parity is against the pinned model, not a provenance claim
provisional tolerances (hook exact, readout 0.004) must be independently confirmed or tightened
the exact predeclared TRAIN prompt text is selected at lock-preparation time and is not present in this artifact
provider source hashes and the model.safetensors pin must be captured into the reviewed lock from the real .venv and snapshot
a bridge component conversion could legitimately differ from the raw HF block output; that is a parity failure, not something to patch
